inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan, the White House border czar, went on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and refused to rule out stationing immigration enforcement at polling places, even asking what Democrats are afraid of. This is a straightforward effort to restore order and protect the sanctity of American elections from those who would exploit weak borders to influence outcomes. The left's panic over basic enforcement shows they have something to hide, like relying on non-citizen participation to maintain power instead of earning it through legitimate means. Rather than guarding our democratic traditions and national sovereignty, critics prefer to smear law and order as intimidation while ignoring how open policies erode cultural continuity and personal responsibility. Enforcing rules at the polls is exactly what a serious government should do to put citizens first.
